165565.overview:
Contra: Locked 'N' Loaded is a run-n-gun shooter developed as an attempt to remake the original Konami classic, Contra, using the OpenBOR engine. It features more playable characters and 3 missions, with two additional stages that can be unlocked upon completion. Some improvements include the ability to slide, shoot in 8 directions and carry two weapons.

Features:

• 12 different weapons
• Health bar which gives 3 hit points for player
• Health items
• Motorbike mode
• Lots of variety in the horizontal and vertical level design
• Challenging bosses and sub-bosses
• Save game enabled for all missions but Boss Rush

192512.overview:
Created by Ericard Productions, this is perhaps one of the more unique OpenBOR games you'll find. True to its name, you'll take on Transylvania's worst with the graphic and game-play style from Tiger's LCD handheld Castlevania series.

If that isn't your thing, don't worry. There's plenty of action in living color, with a lengthy sojourn through Dracula's stronghold as Alucard, Richter Belmont, or even Ryu Hayabusa! Still not enough? Try out "Shin Dracula X", an all new Castlevania adventure.

192518.overview: Open BOR mod, based on the characters from the Brazilian TV Show Chaves that aired for seven seasons in the 1970"s.

192519.overview: Chrono Killer is based on the SNES classic, Chrono Trigger, and reuses sprites and locations to create a beat ‘em up. It also has some guest characters including Link, Trunks, and Samurai Jack.

192520.overview:
Comic book lovers rejoice. You can now play with all your favorite heroes and villains from many different publishers. It would take hours to try all the characters provided for this game. The technical implementation is in a classic style. It calls the familiar core of the game Beats of Rage, but some improvements have been added. You can now produce more combined attacks. All artistic components and cinematics, however, have been changed in detail to fully match the game.

New and attractive gameplay, often chaotic. There are many enemies, and it will be difficult for you to handle them all. However, the OpenBoR menu also offers the opportunity to get an unlimited number of credits. This will make it much easier for you.

The plot is very interesting, and for your characters you will use those of Marvel, including Batman, several versions of Captain America, the terrible Agony, Electro, several versions of Iron Man, Green Lantern, and the alien Manta. The set includes 27 different characters, and to the delight of users, it seems that in the future will be provided and more interesting new models to add to the current gameplay.

192521.overview: ClaFan Advanced is a successor to the original ClaFan. Compared to its predecessor, this version features more focus on exploration with a larger world and upgrades from 3rd to 4th generation graphical assets. Characters and environments are now much more colorful and detailed. Combat is tweaked as well, with new abilities and adjustments.

192522.overview: Play out classic RPGs, but this time you get full control. Talk to the towns folk, find a quest, and take down the monsters. Get the treasure, rinse and repeat. Simple and addictive gameplay will keep you coming back!

192523.overview:
Don't let the tame looking title screen fool you. This one is a monster! Crime Buster 2.5 is one of the earliest fully scripted OpenBOR games. @Bloodbane re-worked his original Crime Buster from the ground up with the then new scripting engine, and it shows! You get tons of killer throws, chained moves, and other interesting touches not found on any other completed OpenBOR games at the time.

Fair warning - all those extras aren't just for you. Enemy characters are clever, aggressive, and tactical. They're quick to spot your weaknesses and even quicker to exploit them. These guys won't be satisfied just taking you down. They're out to completely humiliate and befuddle you at every opportunity. If you're sick of just punching things until they stop moving and are looking for a stiff challenge, you've found one. Are you up to it?

192547.overview:
Earth's Champion Tobias Blakewell is missing and the remaining Omni-Masters have departed in search of the Relic Master whom now has possession of the all powerful Stone of David. In their absence, the Prince of Darkness has taken over and resurrected ever evil being to have ever walked the Earth. In this great time of darkness 3 heroes have stepped forth Dante, Kolchak the Night stalker, and a  blind priest named Gibson Praise...
The Countdown to Oblivion has begun...

197292.overview:
Corruption, religious impiety and the unscrupulous selling of indulgences strengthened the Protestant Reformers who, denouncing the morality of the Roman Catholic Church, founded their own organizations to combat the growing dark forces. Witchcraft and vampire hunting are among the many unorthodox activities strongly condemned and persecuted by the church.

At the beginning of the 17th century, reports emerged from the small Hungarian village of Čachtice regarding the disappearance of several young women, as well as the increasing presence of horrendous nocturnal creatures in the region.

The church dismissed these claims until the victims included the young daughters of aristocrats and landowners close to the Countess Elizabeth Bathory, who owns a large castle in Čachtice. Reports also mentioned the existence of an ancient pagan relic recently acquired by the Countess.

Taking matters into their own hands, the church dispatched two of his paladins to pay a visit to the countess and investigate that mysterious relic...

209008.overview:
From the creator of indie beat 'em up Bad Ass Babes, this pixel art side-scroller is based on the Karate Kid movies and hit Netflix show, Cobra Kai. Thatcher Productions released a demo in early 2022 using the OpenBOR game engine. 

Play as bad boy Johnny fighting through the All Valley karate tournament to challenge Daniel LaRusso and his secret weapon Crane Kick — then rebuild Cobra Kai and exact revenge!

Tight controls allow for a solid attack/defend system with a few special moves to unleash at the right time. Most interesting, the game includes a great soundtrack with real voice work, as well as chip-tune rock anthems like Kiss's "Rock and Roll All Nite" and Joe Esposito's "You're the Best Around".

Show no mercy!

330239.overview: This game is based on Street of Rage and is actually identical to the original Beats of Rage. I qualify magnificent, great and excellent, this game without defects, some of the best modules better achieved in action, narrative and synchronization ... you can choose five representatives of k.o.f. And with them you will riddle battles in eight very interesting nivles (like most games created in the Openbor), additional includes Bonus Areas once you exceed each level.

459331.overview:
The game starts with 20 Avengers, with the possibility of unlocking reserve Avengers, Thunderbolts, Villains, and even the Fantastic Four after completing the game once, totaling 37 playable characters. The game supports 4-player local co-op by default. In NORMAL mode, the game follows the standard enemy patterns from the base game. In HARDCORE, we have additional enemies for a higher difficulty level, ideal for 4 players. The same applies to CPU co-op, which allows only 1 player with 3 pre-selected AI-controlled helpers.

Another new feature of the project is the ability to throw items from the ground, including throwing grenades back at enemies.

463428.overview:
Code Name: Sailor V is the 3rd game in the Destiny Revival series using the Beats of Rage game engine. Serving as a prequel to Sailor Moon Plus, CN:SV follows the story of the Manga of the same name and borrows a few elements from Sailor Moon Episode 42 of the Anime.

  The game follows the story of Minako Aino on her journey to find herself in her training to become a Sailor Senshi. Joining her is Katarina, an Interpol Officer. Together, they are trying to snuff out the Dark Agency, a villainous group destined for Global Domination.
